title: Pig reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Pig body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='28' ry='20' fill='#ff9db5'/>
  <!-- Body highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='22' ry='14' fill='#ffb8cb'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='22' fill='#ff9db5'/>
  <!-- Head highlight -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='38' r='16' fill='#ffb0c4'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='26' rx='8' ry='11' fill='#ff8aa8' transform='rotate(-20 32 26)'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='26' rx='8' ry='11' fill='#ff8aa8' transform='rotate(20 68 26)'/>
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='27' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#ff6f96' transform='rotate(-20 33 27)'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='27' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#ff6f96' transform='rotate(20 67 27)'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='40' r='4' fill='#3a1a2e'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='40' r='4' fill='#3a1a2e'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='39' r='1.5' fill='#ffd1e0'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='39' r='1.5' fill='#ffd1e0'/>
  <!-- Snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='51' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#ff6f96'/>
  <ellipse cx='47' cy='51' rx='2' ry='3' fill='#d94f72'/>
  <ellipse cx='53' cy='51' rx='2' ry='3' fill='#d94f72'/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d='M46 57 Q50 60 54 57' stroke='#d94f72' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Blush -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='48' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ff6f96' opacity='0.6'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='48' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ff6f96' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Book -->
  <rect x='28' y='58' width='44' height='28' rx='3' fill='#4a8bc2'/>
  <rect x='30' y='60' width='19' height='24' fill='#f5f0e6'/>
  <rect x='51' y='60' width='19' height='24' fill='#faf6ee'/>
  <!-- Book spine center -->
  <line x1='50' y1='59' x2='50' y2='85' stroke='#2e6a99' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Book text lines -->
  <line x1='33' y1='65' x2='46' y2='65' stroke='#c7b8a0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='33' y1='69' x2='46' y2='69' stroke='#c7b8a0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='33' y1='73' x2='46' y2='73' stroke='#c7b8a0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='33' y1='77' x2='44' y2='77' stroke='#c7b8a0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='65' x2='67' y2='65' stroke='#c7b8a0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='69' x2='67' y2='69' stroke='#c7b8a0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='73' x2='67' y2='73' stroke='#c7b8a0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='77' x2='65' y2='77' stroke='#c7b8a0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Hooves holding book -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='70' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#ff7fa3'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='70' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#ff7fa3'/>
  <!-- Book cover edges -->
  <rect x='28' y='58' width='44' height='28' rx='3' fill='none' stroke='#3a749e' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Small sparkle above head -->
  <path d='M50 10 L52 16 L58 18 L52 20 L50 26 L48 20 L42 18 L48 16 Z' fill='#ffe066'/>
</svg>
